How to study

1. Look at the picture and name the place or symbol.

2. Press Listen to hear the English name.

3. Flip and read the short fact and Russian translation.

4. Turn it back and explain the fact from memory.

The illustrations and original backs come directly from the supplied printable PDF. Audio uses a voice installed on this device.
